dashboard.interpretation: Functional smoke checks only; not a penetration test or security certification.

typescript.checks: TypeScript compile plus evidence schema, summary, Wilson interval and independent-trial guards

cpp_probe.scope: current process observation only; not a sandbox test
cpp_probe.interpretation: A return code of 2 indicates at least one unavailable or inconclusive observation. It is not proof of isolation and not a security failure verdict.

rust.reason: Rust toolchain is not installed in the build environment.

real_model_inference.reason: No model weights were cached, Transformers/Accelerate were not installed, and model/package downloads could not be reached from this environment. Candidate metadata inspection is not an inference test.

sandbox.required_mode: fails closed before model loading when Bubblewrap is unavailable
sandbox.interpretation: Sandbox command construction and fail-closed logic are unit-tested; actual Bubblewrap namespace execution was not tested in this environment.

isolation_enforcement.notes: No verified kernel-enforced sandbox or complete host-attack resistance is claimed.

zenodo.relationship: User-provided research/data record; DOI metadata not independently verified and the record was not modified by this build.
